description: Test suite for Azure Table Storage data management operations using Orleans framework. Contains unit tests for CRUD operations, conditionally update/insert, and error handling for Azure Table data manager.

classes.name: AzureTableDataManagerTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests validating CRUD and conditional operations for Azure Table Storage within Orleans framework.

methods.name: GenerateNewData
methods.description: Creates a new instance of test data with unique RowKey.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManagerTests
methods.description: Constructor for setting up test environment and initializing the data manager.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_CreateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests creation of table entries and handling of conflict errors when creating duplicate entries.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_UpsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests upsert operation, which inserts or updates a table entry.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_UpdateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests updating table entries, including handling of non-existent entries and ETag precondition checks.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_DeleteTableAsync
methods.description: Tests deletion of table entries and proper handling when deleting non-existent entries.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_MergeTableAsync
methods.description: Tests merging of partial updates to table entries and concurrency control based on ETag.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests retrieval of individual table entries, including non-existent entries.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_InsertTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Tests conditional insertion of two entries with conflict detection based on existence and ETag.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_UpdateTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Tests conditional update of two entries with ETag verification.
